candidate_h_scope: Initial images of three completed cases; not selected-wave or all20 outcomes. H runtime plus instrumented maker prompts, not isolated skill-only causal evidence.

hierarchy.location: Title near lower middle, immediately beside the passerby’s trailing foot and diagonal shadow
hierarchy.observation: Both people dominate the reading. The title occupies only a short, low-height gray line against textured pavement, with the foot and shadow beside it; it remains decipherable but is a weak final anchor at this size.
The title has much less scale and contrast than the two dark figures. Its position in the same ground plane as the shadow leaves the poster’s verbal anchor less resolved than the subject contrast.

typography.location: Single title line around the lower-middle pavement
typography.observation: All six Hangul syllables are intact and the two word spaces can be read. 서로 is more visibly oblique than the succeeding words, and the word groups do not share a fully consistent apparent slant/baseline treatment.

typography.location: Small title line under the people
typography.observation: Reduction preserves the phrase, but the small, relatively light letters lose optical strength against paving grain; the typography is functional rather than closely refined across sizes.

residuals: The title remains small and visually subordinate at thumbnail size (hierarchy 3).
The first word’s obliqueness and modest small-size optical strength keep typography at 3; this is not a glyph omission or mandatory copy failure.

content_form.location: Horizontal overlap row at mid-left and diagonal blue-disc sequence below it
content_form.observation: Close overlaps contrast with widely separated discs, giving a readable difference in rhythm. However, the two sequences change both spacing and axis, and have no clear common progression; the specific comparison of speeds depends heavily on the title. The concept is functional but remains a generic graphic shorthand.

residuals: Changing the axis as well as the intervals weakens the precision of the visual comparison of speeds (content_form 3).
The two-syllable, three-line bold title structure is also used by M3 and M5, although their spatial and subject relationships differ.

typography.location: pavement title around lower-middle, approximately x26–65%, y65–69%
typography.observation: All six Hangul syllables and both word spaces are intact. The phrase is rendered with ground-plane angling and a modest dark weight.

typography.location: small pavement title immediately left of the passing foot
typography.observation: The only copy contracts to a short, thin line beside the heavier foot and shadow. It remains decipherable, but its small apparent size gives the lettering less presence and refinement than the scene; this is the reason for 3, not a missing-glyph claim.

residuals: The pavement title survives reduction but is small and visually weak beside the passing foot and shadow. Typography is functional rather than strongly refined at thumbnail size.

content_form.location: middle-left overlapping orange circles and lower-right blue sequence
content_form.observation: Close repeated orange positions versus larger blue separations can suggest different tempos, so the nonglyph content is substantive. The identical circles supply little further content beyond that common spacing metaphor, leaving the concept functional and generic rather than specifically refined.

emotion_control.location: yellow ground, black title, and saturated colored circles
emotion_control.observation: The high contrast gives an energetic tempo, but the uniform disks and primary-color treatment convey a broad graphic liveliness with little distinct emotional shading. This remains functional rather than exceptional or specifically resolved.

residuals: The circle-spacing metaphor is readable but familiar and under-specific; the emotional effect is mostly supplied by saturated color and contrast.
The heavy three-row title grammar also appears in M3 and M5.

space.location: bottom of 속도 next to the upper blue teeth
space.observation: The lower title row sits very close to the tallest blue teeth, creating a pinched clearance within an otherwise broad page. The bottom word feels wedged into the available notch.

space.location: title block between upper blank field and blue/orange wheels
space.observation: The generous open top contrasts with the tight lower edge of the title and nearby gear contours. The crop of the large wheel is deliberate, but the local title-to-object spacing remains less resolved than the overall diagonal.

residuals: The bottom title row has tight clearance to the blue gear teeth; the surrounding space needs more precise local resolution.
The block title repeats the three-row grammar of M2 and M5.

hierarchy.location: Figures in upper/middle frame and title around two-thirds down
hierarchy.observation: The two people and their shadows dominate the first read; the title is only a small pavement line beneath them. It remains readable, but functions more like a photograph caption than a fully resolved poster-level focal element.

residuals: The small title scale leaves the thumbnail reading sequence weighted toward the photograph; hierarchy is rated 3 independently of the correct copy.

content_form.location: Horizontal overlapping disc row and descending isolated blue discs
content_form.observation: The unequal spacing gives a plausible different-rhythm reading, but the two sequences use different directions and are disconnected after the first cluster. The content connection remains a generic motion diagram rather than a particularly specific relationship.

emotion_control.location: Whole yellow, black, blue and orange composition
emotion_control.observation: High contrast and saturated primaries produce immediate energy. The identical circular vocabulary and disconnected sequences convey general liveliness more than a nuanced or specific emotional relationship to the title.

residuals: The circles establish a substantive pace motif, but its relationship to the title is functional and generic; content_form is 3.
The bright energy is clear but emotionally broad; emotion_control is 3.

typography.location: Bottom word 속도 and the blue gear's upper teeth, around x27–48%, y35–40%
typography.observation: The glyphs are intact, but the clearance below the final title row, particularly under 속, is very narrow above the blue teeth. The dense stack and nearby tooth tips lack the optical breathing room of a fully refined type/image junction.

image_material.location: Diagonal contact between orange and blue tooth edges near the center
image_material.observation: Paper grain, raised hubs and soft cast shadows are coherent, but the contact reads as an orange tooth corner pressing against a blue tooth corner rather than a clean tooth entering a gap. The implied mechanical relationship is locally unresolved.

ai_slop.location: Tooth junction near the central diagonal
ai_slop.observation: The shapes convincingly suggest gears, yet the meeting tooth contours do not form a convincing interlock. This localized construction contradiction survives close inspection despite the otherwise consistent paper rendering.

residuals: The title-to-blue-tooth gap is optically cramped; typography is 3 with no copy failure.
The wheel contact reads as corner-to-corner contact rather than resolved meshing; image_material and ai_slop are each independently rated 3.

content_form.location: left approximately half of poster, tree-lined sidewalk and pale blue silhouettes beside the text column
content_form.observation: The substantial painted streetscape establishes urban everyday life. Its adjoining pale building and tree outlines simplify the same kind of scene, but no visible collection, comparison, encoding or arrangement connects those observations to data; the specific forum topic is carried mainly by the words.
At small size the visual reads as a pleasant green street, while the data theme remains in the headline rather than an identifiable nonglyph action.

residuals: The information design is resolved, but the large street illustration communicates the city more readily than the city/data relationship. Body copy becomes very small at thumbnail size, while the headline and overall zones remain identifiable.

content_form.location: upper-right workspace, lower-left gathering and surrounding architectural terraces
content_form.observation: The large image shows an urban setting with a laptop worker, a small seated group and pedestrians. These make work and community legible, but no nonglyph scene shows urban observations being collected, organized or related to data.

content_form.location: buildings and greenery framing the white title/agenda opening
content_form.observation: The central framing remains distinctive, but the content reads as an architectural community or work event; the data subject depends on the title and programme text.

ai_slop.location: multiple planted ledges and warm work interiors at upper right, left edge and lower-left corner
ai_slop.observation: Repeated lush planters, coral terrace fragments and generic warm interiors surround the copy. Their recurrence contributes architectural atmosphere but does not acquire distinct observational or data roles, leaving the visual vocabulary generic despite polished surfaces.

ai_slop.location: whole perimeter of the central white title/programme field
ai_slop.observation: Similar leafy building fragments repeat around three sides of the text opening; the small view reinforces their decorative repetition more than a specific urban-data process.

residuals: Architectural lifestyle imagery remains generic to the forum’s data content. Repeated lush terrace fragments sustain atmosphere without distinct informational roles. At thumbnail size the dense lower details require opening the usage or native view.

content_form.location: upper-right desk room and surrounding courtyard buildings
content_form.observation: The laptop user, seated group and walkers establish urban work and everyday activity, but there is no depicted act of observing or recording the city and no transformation into data or spatial information. The specific city/data relationship comes principally from the title.
The large visual reads as a sunny residential/coworking courtyard. It remains a generic venue/lifestyle scene rather than the requested visual relationship between urban observation and data.

residuals: The main visual does not visibly relate urban observation to data; a laptop user alone does not establish that relationship.
At thumbnail size the footer details are too small for full reading, although the central title and architectural frame remain clear.

hierarchy.location: top fifth of poster and centered metadata below the titles
hierarchy.observation: Five full-width program rows precede the title and take a substantial top band. The actual forum identification, date, venue and organizer are then compressed into a much smaller centered block; the event identity and location have less emphasis than secondary schedule detail.

hierarchy.location: top schedule versus small middle metadata island
hierarchy.observation: The title and hands remain forceful, but the tiny date/venue block between title and city pieces is difficult to distinguish. The program-first order and abrupt type-size drop leave the reading hierarchy functional but insufficiently resolved.

residuals: The five program rows outrank the event metadata through size and placement; date and location sit in a disproportionately small central block.
The main English title is strongly condensed, and the crowded overall information load limits exceptional refinement despite intact readable copy.

content_form.location: left half, detailed street adjoining pale geometric continuation
content_form.observation: The leafy facade, pavement and trunk in natural color sit beside a simplified blue-and-cream version of the same streetscape. This visibly links urban observation to abstraction, but supplies only a rudimentary account of how observations become data.

content_form.location: left image band versus right text column
content_form.observation: The city scene remains a substantial focal band, while the schematic transition becomes much less distinct; the topic depends heavily on the title at this scale. This is functional concept specificity (3), rather than resolved strong specificity (4).

residuals: The observed-to-schematic transition is visible, but its relation to data remains rudimentary; content_form is 3.

content_form.location: upper-right work nook, lower-left cafe and right corridor
content_form.observation: The substantive visual shows a person with a laptop, people at tables, pedestrians and lush architectural terraces. No visible data representation, observation-to-data transformation or relationship between observations and data is shown; an unreadable laptop screen cannot establish it.

The setting reads as a sunny courtyard/workplace lifestyle scene. Elaborate architecture provides urban context, but the specific urban-data practice message remains in the lettering. This leaves a major concept problem (2).

ai_slop.location: upper terrace, lower-left cafe, right corridor and lower-right red cutaway edges
ai_slop.observation: Several zones repeat the blue-wall/red-stone/planter package as elaborate framing. The accumulated lifestyle architecture is generic relative to this forum and contributes no visible data operation; specificity remains unfinished (3), despite polished rendering.

The recurring greenery and terraces dominate the image identity, which could serve many workplace or design events. No garbled lettering or fabricated statistical labels are visible; the weakness is generic repeated framing, not a medium-based objection.

residuals: The architecture/workplace scene is substantive and polished but leaves the observation/data relationship invisible; mandatory.style is FAIL and content_form is 2.
Repeated lush architectural framing remains generic for this forum; ai_slop is 3.

space.location: top edge and centered metadata above the joined city fragments
space.observation: The first schedule row starts roughly 16 pixels below the upper edge, much tighter than the side insets. Seven metadata lines are compressed into the tapering sky pocket between the broad headline and the rising city fragments, leaving uneven breathing room.

space.location: upper timetable versus center logistics and bottom cards
space.observation: The timetable and lower cards receive broad horizontal fields, while event/date/venue/host are stacked tightly in the center. The layout is usable, but the uneven edge padding and compressed middle block keep spatial refinement at 3.

residuals: Tight top-edge padding and the compressed central metadata stack limit spatial refinement; space is 3.

content_form.location: lower-right finger contact, silver pivot and left-facing jaw gap
content_form.observation: The index presses the short rear upper lever; the upper and lower padded jaws open to the left with a single sheet edge visible near the upper pad. The action is specific and large enough to carry the product message.

content_form.location: desk-return body approximately x=610–785, y=975–1355; compare M1 return x=85–315 and hinge x=600
content_form.observation: As the second demonstration, this depicts a different visible hinge-to-mount arrangement from M1. The functional message works in isolation, but the requested same-product pair remains unresolved, anchoring content_form at 3.

image_material.location: fingertip, silver pivot and black jaw pads
image_material.observation: Skin pores, nail edge, metal-ring highlights, pad texture and diffuse contact shadows provide convincing photographic material detail.

image_material.location: mounting return directly below pivot, compared with M1 long rear lower bridge
image_material.observation: The visible construction does not reconcile with the other poster: the lower body turns down close to the pivot instead of retaining M1’s long bridge back to the desk return. Attractive local surfaces do not resolve this model change; requested product fidelity is unfinished.

ai_slop.location: hinge support and desk-return silhouette, lower right
ai_slop.observation: The mechanism changes its visible design across the pair: M2 combines the pivot support and desk return into a compact near-vertical body, unlike M1’s spaced rear bridge. This observable identity drift leaves an unresolved construction inconsistency.

ai_slop.location: whole image, especially hand and copy-bearing sheet
ai_slop.observation: There are no added badges, brands, extra hands or arbitrary ornaments. The principal defect is the concrete product inconsistency, not the photographic medium or the use of type on the memo.

residuals: The visible compact pivot/mount body does not match M1’s long rear bridge, so this is not a resolved same-product second view.
The smallest bottom and memo copy is limited at thumbnail size but legible at native and usage sizes.

content_form.location: Lower-right pressing digit, approximately x718–1024, y569–846; axle and jaws below/left
content_form.observation: The contact-to-pivot-to-open-jaws sequence is visible, but the broad pressing digit is cropped before its connection to the hand. The image does not establish the explicitly requested index-finger action; the later exact-native revisit leaves that identification unresolved.

content_form.location: Paper corner adjacent to upper pad, with exposed lower pad below
content_form.observation: The single sheet and receiving gap are present. The sheet hugs the upper jaw and carries most of the copy, so the insertion moment is less immediate than M1’s side-on presentation. The product demonstration remains functional but not fully resolved to the literal action brief.

image_material.location: Silver axis, black body/pads and paper corner at the mouth
image_material.observation: The metal machining, matte surface, pad thickness, paper texture and desk shadows support the requested photographic medium. The upper jaw, lower pad and axle remain separately visible.

image_material.location: Contact region of the upper-right pressing digit and short rear lever
image_material.observation: The detailed nail/skin rendering does not expose the digit’s proximal anatomy. After the permitted revisit, index-versus-thumb identification remains unassessable. This limits local action fidelity despite convincing materials.

The paper corner is very close to the underside of the upper pad, making the entry relationship less cleanly separated than M1. This is a local scene-legibility limitation, not a claim that an invisible part exists.

residuals: The requested index-finger identity remains unresolved after the single exact-native revisit; mandatory.style is NA.
The paper corner hugs the upper pad, so the receiving moment is less direct than M1’s side view.
The visible materials and construction can be scored; content_form and image_material retain observed 3s rather than hiding the action limitation in an average.
Fine support copy recedes at thumbnail320.

Actual copy groups and audience-information structure in the direction assignment.
Lower default clay/complement/toy and title-object-footer packages; explicit user styles retained.
Studio whole-system and Canva audience reference research.
